key_points: XOM shares fell ~5% on Sep 22 with no clear fundamental catalyst.
Talks of returning to Venezuela after 19 years remain preliminary; market reaction muted.
Refining margins and potential upside cited by RBC could offset Middle East earnings exposure.
Carbon capture expansion plans target up to 100 mtpa CO2 storage on Gulf Coast.
Some valuation models flag XOM as overvalued (~24-27% above GF value).
